preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, the size of the matrix n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == n for row in b)
preconditions.description: Each row of the binary matrix b must have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in row) for row in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in the binary matrix b must be either '0' or '1'.
The sum of n over all test cases must not exceed 1000.

postconditions.description: Each set A_i must be nonempty.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(A_i)) == len(A_i) for A_i in sets)
postconditions.description: Each set A_i must consist of distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted(A_i)) for A_i in sets)) == n
postconditions.description: All sets A_i must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all((b[i][j] == '1') == (A_i < A_j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: For all pairs (i, j), b[i][j] must be '1' if and only if A_i is a proper subset of A_j.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for A_i in sets for x in A_i)
postconditions.description: All elements in each set A_i must be integers between 1 and n inclusive.
